intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, Chhattisgarh, but they are different kinds of university. This page compares recorded fees and flags what is missing, using official sites opened in {{year}}.

Hidayatullah National Law University vs The ICFAI University, Raipur is a public national law university against a private university. The short title is abbreviated; use the table names when you read the fees.

sections.heading: HNLU Raipur vs ICFAI University Raipur for Ph.D: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose HNLU Raipur if you want a doctorate in law at a public national law university, and you will budget from the official fee notice rather than from the small admission and application rows.
Choose The ICFAI University, Raipur if you want a private-university Doctor of Philosophy at the recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹80,000, after you confirm the subject and supervisor.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For HNLU we hold several Ph.D in Law heads: ₹15,000 tuition a year, ₹23,000 other fees, ₹5,000 hostel, ₹5,000 security, plus ₹1,000 admission and ₹1,500 application amounts. The admission and application rows are not the doctoral tuition.
For The ICFAI University, Raipur we hold ₹80,000 as a Total Fees year figure for the Doctor of Philosophy. That is a year amount, not a confirmed multi-year official total.
Do not quote HNLU's ₹1,000 admission fee as the cheapest Ph.D option. Recheck both official notices on hnlu.ac.in and the ICFAI Raipur site before you compare cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no Ph.D placement row for either university, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Doctoral outcomes usually depend on the thesis, publications and the job you seek after, not a campus MBA-style package. Ask both doctoral offices about recent completions and fellowships.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. National law universities and private universities typically run their own doctoral tests and interviews, so follow the official Ph.D notification.
HNLU's listed programme is a Ph.D in Law. ICFAI's listed row is a generic Doctor of Philosophy. Confirm the exact subject and supervisor before you apply.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, so a local student can visit them without leaving the city.
HNLU is a public national law university. ICFAI University Raipur is a private university. The academic community and research setting will not feel the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick HNLU Raipur if a public NLU doctorate in law is what you want, and you have the official fee schedule, not only our itemised heads.
Pick The ICFAI University, Raipur if the recorded ₹80,000 year fee and a confirmed supervisor in your subject fit your plan.
Because placements are missing, let the research area, university type and official fee decide this comparison.

faqs.question: Is the HNLU Ph.D fee only ₹1,000?
faqs.answer: No. The ₹1,000 row is an admission fee, and ₹1,500 is an application fee. Recorded tuition is ₹15,000 a year, with other, hostel and security heads also listed. Use the official fee notice.

faqs.question: What Ph.D fee is on record for The ICFAI University, Raipur?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹80,000 as a Total Fees year figure. That is not a confirmed multi-year official total. Check the university fee notice before you budget.

faqs.question: Are Ph.D placements listed for these universities?
faqs.answer: No. We have no doctoral placement row for either side. Ask the doctoral offices about recent completions and fellowships.

faqs.question: Is HNLU a government university?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our records list Hidayatullah National Law University as a public university and The ICFAI University, Raipur as a private university, both in Raipur.

faqs.question: Do these Ph.D programmes use the same entrance exam?
faqs.answer: This page has no exam mapped for either side. Follow each university's official doctoral notification for tests, interviews and eligibility.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Raipur?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.
